pairs: Et egressa est sors secunda filiorum Simeon per cognationes suas:
And the second lot went out, for the sons of Simeon by their families.
eorum in medio possessionis filiorum Juda:
in the midst of the possession of the sons of Judah:
Ain et Remmon et Athar et Asan:
Ain and Enrimmon, and Ether and Ashan:
omnes viculi per circuitum urbium istarum usque ad Baalath Beer Ramath contra australem plagam.
all villages around these cities, as far as Baalath-beer, the high place facing the southern region.
Hæc est hæreditas filiorum Simeon juxta cognationes suas,
This is the inheritance of the sons of Simeon, according to their families,
within the possession and lot of the sons of Judah,
et idcirco filii Simeon possederunt in medio hæreditatis eorum.
the sons of Simeon had a possession in the midst of their inheritance.
Ceciditque sors tertia filiorum Zabulon per cognationes suas:
And the third lot fell to the sons of Zebulun, by their families;
factus est terminus possessionis eorum usque Sarid.
and the limit of their possession was set as far as Sarid.
And it ascends from the sea and from Mareal.
And it passes on to Dabbesheth,
usque ad torrentem qui est contra Jeconam.
Et revertitur de Sared contra orientem in fines Ceseleththabor:
And it turns back from Sarid, to the east, to the end of Chisloth-tabor.
And it goes out to Daberath,
Et inde pertransit usque ad orientalem plagam Gethepher
it continues to the eastern region of Gathhepher and Ethkazin.
And it circles to the north at Hannathon.
And its exits are at the Valley of Iphtahel;
et Cateth et Naalol et Semeron et Jerala et Bethlehem:
and Kattath and Nahalal, and Shimron and Idalah, and Bethlehem:
Hæc est hæreditas tribus filiorum Zabulon per cognationes suas,
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun,
Issachar egressa est sors quarta per cognationes suas:
The fourth lot went out to Issachar, by their families.
fuitque ejus hæreditas Jezraël et Casaloth et Sunem
And his inheritance was: Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
Et pervenit terminus ejus usque Thabor et Sehesima et Bethsames,
And its limit reaches to Tabor and Shahazumah and Beth-shemesh;
and its exits shall be at the Jordan:
Hæc est possessio filiorum Issachar per cognationes suas,
This is the possession of the sons of Issachar by their families,
Ceciditque sors quinta tribui filiorum Aser per cognationes suas:
And the fifth lot fell to the tribe of the sons of Asher, by their families.
fuitque terminus eorum Halcath et Chali et Beten et Axaph
And their border was: Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
et pervenit usque ad Carmelum maris
And it extends even to Carmel by the sea,
And it turns back toward the east at Bethdagon.
And it continues on as far as Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtahel,
et vallem Jephthaël contra aquilonem in Bethemec
And it goes out to the left of Cabul,
as far as the great Sidon.
Revertiturque in Horma usque ad civitatem munitissimam Tyrum,
And it turns back at Ramah, even to the very fortified city of Tyre,
eruntque exitus ejus in mare de funiculo Achziba:
And its exits shall be at the sea, from the lot of Achzib;
Hæc est possessio filiorum Aser per cognationes suas,
This is the possession of the sons of Asher,
and the cities and their villages.
Filiorum Nephthali sexta sors cecidit per familias suas:
The sixth lot fell to the sons of Naphtali, by their families.
et cœpit terminus de Heleph et Elon in Saananim,
And its border begins from Heleph and Elon, into Zaanannim,
and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum.
et egressus eorum usque ad Jordanem:
And its exits are as far as the Jordan.
revertiturque terminus contra occidentem in Azanotthabor,
And the border turns back to the west at Aznoth-tabor,
and it goes out from there to Hukkok.
et pertransit in Zabulon contra meridiem,
And continues on to Zebulun, in the south,
and to Asher, in the west, and to Judah,
et in Juda ad Jordanem contra ortum solis:
at the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun.
And the most fortified cities are Ziddim,
civitates decem et novem, et villæ earum.
Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Nephthali per cognationes suas,
This is the possession of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali,
Tribui filiorum Dan per familias suas egressa est sors septima:
The seventh lot went out to the tribe of the sons of Dan, by their families.
et fuit terminus possessionis ejus Sara
And the border of their possession was Zorah,
et Jud et Bane et Barach et Gethremmon:
and Jehud, and Bene and Berak, and Gath-Rimmon,
with a border that looks toward Joppa,
and there the last part is concluded.
And the sons of Dan ascended
et percusserunt eam in ore gladii,
And they struck it with the mouth of the sword,
calling it by the name of Leshem-Dan,
according to the name of their father Dan.
Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Dan,
This is the possession of the tribe of the sons of Dan,
Cumque complesset sorte dividere terram singulis per tribus suas,
And when he had completed dividing the land by lot to each one by their tribes,
dederunt filii Israël possessionem Josue filio Nun in medio sui,
the sons of Israel gave a possession to Joshua, the son of Nun, in their midst,
in accord with the precept of the Lord,
urbem quam postulavit Thamnath Saraa in monte Ephraim:
the city he requested, Timnath-Serah, on mount Ephraim.
And he built up the city,
Hæ sunt possessiones, quas sorte diviserunt Eleazar sacerdos,
These are the possessions which Eleazar, the priest,
and Joshua, the son of Nun,
et principes familiarum ac tribuum filiorum Israël in Silo,
and the leaders of the families and tribes of the sons of Israel divided by lot at Shiloh,
coram Domino ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii:
before the Lord, at the door of the Tabernacle of the Testimony.
And so did they divide the land.
